findings.text: follow-on: the stage returns a no-op {"sources_judged": 0} for --scan-only and carries --topic (map.py:111) without reaching any worker, because candidates drains the sources the signals stage seeded and has no seeding half, so the §3 fold done-when items naming a seeding worker and a --topic scorer/enricher do not apply and the sequence runner must model candidates as drain-only.

follow-on: the manifest sets after_suite to the negative-control log and both suites claim base revision df596be2 while the logs' own headers read rev=ed4fdf1d3, so the derived added failure test_flush_runs_the_draining_worker is the run's declared negative control rather than a regression the change introduced.

item_verdicts.diff: read ed4fdf1d3 against df596be2; the change extracts run_candidates_stage and the frozen CandidatesStageOptions, adds a --scan-only no-worker early return for the drain-only domain, keeps the run_discovery body whole and turns the click command into a thin wrapper.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names a new test file showing --scan-only/--flush select the halves, --topic reaches its target, --limit caps items and --focus is honoured or refused, with the old command's tests still passing; tests/cli/test_discover_candidates_stage.py shows all four (with --scan-only a no-op and --focus a UsageError naming section 7), tests/cli/test_discover_map.py is unchanged, and the gate records 18 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: §3 fold-candidates-stage asks for run_candidates_stage(facility, options) with a frozen dataclass of settled options, extracted from the discover map click command with the engine body kept whole and the command left as a thin wrapper; imas_codex/cli/discover/map.py:57 exposes the stage function, map.py:27 the frozen CandidatesStageOptions, map.py:121-181 keeps the DiscoveryConfig/run_discovery body whole and map.py:221-250 leaves map_candidates a thin wrapper, so the extraction is present, though the plan's generic --scan-only-seeds and --topic-reaches-a-scorer items are vacuous for this drain-only domain.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head gate at 18 passed EXIT=0 and a negative control at 1 failed EXIT=1, but its baseline_suite and after_suite both name revision df596be2 while their logs' headers read rev=ed4fdf1d3, and its after_suite points at the negative-control log rather than a post-change suite.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares imas_codex/cli/discover/map.py, tests/cli/test_discover_candidates_stage.py and the evidence fragment; git diff --stat df596be2..ed4fdf1d3 touches exactly those three files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log mutates the stage so --flush takes the no-worker path and test_flush_runs_the_draining_worker fails at tests/cli/test_discover_candidates_stage.py:76 (assert len(engine_calls)==1 reads 0==1, EXIT=1) where the green gate passes it, so the drain-half guard is shown to fire.
justifications.evidence: gate.log records the done-when gate at 18 passed EXIT=0 at rev ed4fdf1d3 with the four named behaviours, but the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite both name revision df596be2 while the log headers read rev=ed4fdf1d3 and after_suite names the negative-control log, so the suite revision record is muddled.
justifications.fit: the added symbols run_candidates_stage and CandidatesStageOptions are named by what they do with no plan label, and map.py follows the sibling discover domains' stage-plus-thin-wrapper idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: map.py:57 exposes the stage function and map.py:121-181 keeps the engine body whole, but the plan's generic --scan-only-runs-the-seeding-worker and --topic-reaches-the-scorer items do not apply to the drain-only candidates domain (map.py:92 returns a no-op, map.py:111 only logs the topic), so the landed change realises §3 as far as the domain allows.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses DiscoveryConfig, run_discovery, CandidateDiscoveryState and run_candidate_engine unchanged (map.py:75-181) and forks no capability; a search over imas_codex/cli/discover and imas_codex/ids found no other owner of a candidates stage.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat df596be2..ed4fdf1d3 touches only imas_codex/cli/discover/map.py, tests/cli/test_discover_candidates_stage.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
